description: Returns latest hourly air quality and volcanic gas (SO2, H2S, PM10, PM2.5, NO2, O3, CO) measurements from Iceland's Environment and Energy Agency (api.ust.is / loftgaedi.is), optionally ranked by distance to a place (max 20).

place.description: Optional town, landmark, or station name (e.g. Reykjavík, Grindavík, Keflavík, Akureyri).

name: get_air_quality
title: Get Iceland Air Quality & SO₂ Readings
